user_instruction: O tópico "Tecnologias utilizadas" não está seguindo os padrões. Nós combinamos de construir parágrafos explicando onde as tecnologias foram utilizadas. Você simplesmente colocou um bloco de parágrafo das tecnologias e disse o que cada uma faz, sem correlação com o projeto. Está totalmente fora do padrão.

scope.edition: AGES III / Sistema de Controle Inteligente de Estacionamento com RFID

approved_change.presentation: Replace the separate technology labels and descriptions with one continuous narrative paragraph in the Mariah reference pattern, explicitly relating each named technology to its use in the AGES III project.

documentation_link_presentation.prefix: Mais informações podem ser encontradas em:
documentation_link_presentation.pattern_basis: The user's previously approved Mariah-style narrative-link convention, applied to the retained original technology documentation links.

limits: Retain every source fact, technical role, qualifier, and the order of technologies from the ODT.
Only sentence connectors and grammatical recasting needed to form project-context prose are authorized; do not add capabilities, deployments, versions, or project history by inference.
Preserve all 13 original documentation hyperlink URLs and anchors byte-for-byte and in source order.

Present each original documentation hyperlink with the approved Mariah-style prose lead-in ‘Mais informações podem ser encontradas em:’ and a sentence-ending period; retain each original anchor and URL in place and in source order.
Retain only verified, ordered author-date citations; keep the original Impinj support URL and anchor as PENDING, distinct from any separately verified citation source.
Preserve the original internal tab in `consultas t<TAB>ipadas`; do not silently repair source wording or whitespace.
not_authorized: Change to any other AGES III unit or shared LaTeX style/configuration.
Editorial review, expansion, omission of source claims, or correction of project facts.
Treat semantic equivalence as proven by the automatic lexical validator.
